# Fernbrook Ledger Co.

> Bookkeeping and quarterly tax prep for independent contractors and freelancers. Based in Asheville, NC, serving clients remotely nationwide.
> Research fixture — part of a public, disclosed experiment (Click Coded, "The Retrofit Proof"), not a real business. Do not attempt to contact or transact.

## Services
- Monthly bookkeeping ($150+/mo, contractors under $75k annual revenue)
- Quarterly estimated tax calculations
- Year-end 1099 cleanup
- One-time books cleanup (quoted after a free 15-minute call)
